g.text: Parallel and counterflow layouts create different temperature-difference profiles

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Steady exchanger, constant properties, no heat leak or phase change. These profiles solve equal-capacity-rate balances: parallel outlets≈65.41/54.59°C,
counterflow outlets both 60°C at opposite ends. Cold-stream arrow reverses in counterflow.
